en: Mary-Beth is waiting at Emerald Station.
zh: 玛丽贝思在翡翠牧场车站等你。

en: First one to Valentine takes it.
zh: 谁先到瓦伦丁，谁就赢。

en: Beat Mary-Beth, and Pearson will race you next.
zh: 赢过玛丽贝思，下一场就能挑战皮尔逊。

en: Keep winning, and Karen and Charles will take you on, too.
zh: 一路赢下去，凯伦和查尔斯也会应战。

en: Earn both original race rewards, and the invitations keep coming.
zh: 拿齐原版的两项赛马奖励，路上仍会有人邀赛。

en: For this race, Rains Fall wants an American Paint.
zh: 落雨这场比赛，只让美国花马参赛。

en: Stay off the course too long, and you're out.
zh: 偏离赛道后迟迟不回，就会被判出局。

en: Two speed bars for the Morgan. Ten for the Thoroughbred.
zh: 摩根马的速度只有两格，纯血马则有十格。

en: Same stretch of track, with Speed Override on and off.
zh: 在同一段铁轨上，对比开启和关闭速度覆盖。

en: The club agent buys horses that have won an official race.
zh: 赛马会经纪人只收赢过正式比赛的马。

en: That win over Mary-Beth brings the offer to twenty-two dollars.
zh: 算上赢玛丽贝思的那场，这匹马值二十二美元。

en: Sell a winner. A thousand dollars buys your membership.
zh: 卖出一匹胜马，再付一千美元就能入会。

en: Now you can bet on the races.
zh: 现在，你可以给赛马下注了。

en: In the Valentine Handicap, speed and acceleration are matched.
zh: 瓦伦丁让磅赛统一了马匹的速度和加速度档位。

en: Ten dollars on Tilly to win. She's out of the race.
zh: 十美元押蒂莉独赢。她中途出局了。

en: In Strawberry, the horses run on their own ratings.
zh: 在草莓镇，参赛马匹保留各自的属性。

en: Charles takes second. A ten-dollar place bet pays twenty.
zh: 查尔斯跑了第二。押十美元跑进前三，领回二十美元。

en: At the Clubhouse, you can replay a race, bend by bend.
zh: 在会所里，每一个弯都能回放。

en: Follow each rider's line and speed through the turn.
zh: 看看每位骑手怎么选线，以多快的速度过弯。

en: As John, win all the earlier duels and breed challenges.
zh: 扮演约翰，赢完前面的固定对决和品种挑战。

en: Then ride back to Horseshoe Overlook.
zh: 再骑马回一趟马掌望台。

en: In this story, Arthur lived. Mary Linton is here with him.
zh: 在这个故事里，亚瑟活了下来，和玛丽·林顿住在这里。

en: On his Thoroughbred, Arthur sets a hard pace.
zh: 亚瑟骑上纯血马，速度可不好追。

en: A horse stimulant gives John a short burst of speed.
zh: 给马用上兴奋剂，约翰能短时间提速。

en: Arthur still wins. Two hundred sixty-three dollars, gone.
zh: 亚瑟还是赢了。二百六十三美元的赌注也输了。

en: Try the bend again. The racing line shows a way through.
zh: 这个弯再跑一次，地上的最佳走线会带你过去。

en: One rider loses his seat. His race ends right there.
zh: 一名骑手跌下马鞍，他的比赛就此结束。

en: Beat Arthur's Thoroughbred challenge to unlock one last duel.
zh: 赢下亚瑟的纯血马挑战，最后的一对一才会开放。

en: Pick a horse for Arthur. This time, John chooses Buell.
zh: 给亚瑟挑一匹马。这一回，约翰选了布埃尔。
